program_name: Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology
requirement_text: Admission is based on either the SAT or the ACT test results or on the grades obtained in the Finnish Matriculation Examination, or in the IB, EB or DIA/RP diploma.
source_authority_note: aalto.fi is the official domain of Aalto University, Espoo (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.aalto.fi). Finnish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: The applicant does not choose their route -- it is determined by which qualification they hold. For an international applicant without a Finnish matriculation, IB, EB or a DIA/RP taken in Finland, SAT or ACT is not an option but a requirement.
researcher_notes: Finland's technical universities require a US admissions test from most international applicants. This is counter-intuitive for a European destination and is exactly the kind of fact that changes a student's plan twelve months out. ORYN's advisor cannot surface it if the requirement is stored only as 'standardised test: optional'.

program_name: Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology
requirement_text: In Aalto Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology, 70 per cent of the available study places in Admission Group III are reserved for applicants applying for their first higher education degree (quota for first time applicants). ... You are considered a first-time applicant, if you have not: completed a higher education degree in Finland; accepted a study place leading to a higher education degree in Finland on 1 August 2014 or later
source_authority_note: aalto.fi is the official domain of Aalto University, Espoo (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.aalto.fi). Finnish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: A statutory Finnish first-timer quota. Note it is scoped to Finnish higher education only -- a degree or accepted place elsewhere does not disqualify -- and it is anchored to a fixed historical date, 1 August 2014.
researcher_notes: Competitive position depends on a fact about the applicant's history that has nothing to do with their grades. Ranked selection against a reserved sub-quota is not representable as a threshold at all.

program_name: Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology
requirement_text: Please note that Aalto University's application to English-taught bachelor's programmes, the first joint application and the second joint application are separate admissions, and completely separate processes. If you wish to apply in several application rounds, you must submit an application form separately for each application period.
source_authority_note: aalto.fi is the official domain of Aalto University, Espoo (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.aalto.fi). Finnish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Qualifies the 'centralised national portal' picture for Finland. Studyinfo/Opintopolku is the form system, but Aalto's English-taught bachelor's admission is its own round, not one of the two national joint applications. Portal != single competition.

requirement_text: In Finland, tuition fees are collected from students who are citizens of countries other than those of the European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA) or Switzerland. Tuition fees apply to degree programmes taught in English. ... Students of a bachelor's or master's degree programme taught in Finnish or Swedish (language proficiency is required) [do not pay tuition fees].
source_authority_note: aalto.fi is the official domain of Aalto University, Espoo (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.aalto.fi). Finnish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Finland's fee liability is a conjunction: non-EU/EEA citizenship AND English-taught programme. A non-EU student who can study in Finnish pays nothing. Sweden's rule is citizenship alone. Modelling either country's rule as the other's produces a wrong answer for a real and growing population of students.

requirement_text: Bachelor's programmes -- Tuition fees for rights to study beginning on or after 1 August 2025: Field of Business EUR 12 000 per academic year; Fields of Art and Architecture EUR 15 000 per academic year; Field of Technology EUR 12 000 per academic year. Master's programmes: Field of Business EUR 15 000; Fields of Art and Architecture EUR 20 000; Field of Technology EUR 17 000; Multidisciplinary programmes EUR 17 000.
source_authority_note: aalto.fi is the official domain of Aalto University, Espoo (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.aalto.fi). Finnish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Bound to when the study right BEGINS ('on or after 1 August 2025'), not to an application cycle. The page also states 'The individual student's fee will remain the same throughout the completion of the programme' at Helsinki; Aalto reserves the right to change levels.
researcher_notes: A fee keyed to study-right commencement is a third dating convention alongside cycle-year and academic-year. Recorded verbatim rather than normalised.
